result_summary.title: Rate limit exceeded on Analytics Dashboard (US-West)
result_summary.description: We are hitting rate limits on the Analytics Dashboard in US-West production, preventing about 18 users from accessing reports. This is moderate impact. We believe this is because of insufficient capacity planning on your end, as we haven't changed our query volume recently. Please increase our limits.
